messages:
Aisha: Proposed: temporary pin at routing layer to keep runtime 2.18 for any requests that carry model groups labelled 'legacy-embed' while we validate runtime-3.4 embedding fidelity. Window: 2026-04-10T23:45:00Z for 6h.
Tom: Why routing-pin vs full revert? we only need to protect a small subset of models.
Aisha: Exactly. Routing pin avoids global rollback and keeps majority on 3.4. We'll route legacy-embed models to runtime-2.18 compat pool.
Vera: Rollout plan: apply pin rule in dry-run for 15m, then live. Traffic cohorts unaffected since it's model-scoped.
Jules: Rollback triggers: embedding cosine drift >0.02 avg on sample set OR error rate +0.3% -> remove rule.
Aisha: deploybot, add exemption list for internal-test models and canary bots so we don't mask regressions.
deploybot: deploybot: sdk-pin-rule draft created by @Aisha  dry-run scheduled at 2026-04-10T23:45:00Z. Excludes: internal-canary, modelgrp:mg-test.
ops-bot: ops-bot: capacity check OK; compat pool headroom 15%. Automatic cache-drain configured on switched nodes.
Tom: Please capture perf snapshots + a 5-minute raw-embed sample for postmortem.
Vera: I'll add the smoke script to run at +10m of dry-run. Jules: you'll watch metrics.
Jules: ack. If thresholds breach we'll revert rule and open incident.
Aisha: Docs note ready; will ping CS and post banner 10m before live.
Tom: ack. No objections from me.
deploybot: deploybot: dry-run executed; routing matches expected model ids; no image issues. Live apply pending manual confirm.
Aisha: I'll apply live in 10. Thanks team.
